title: as_strided 的重叠视图写破坏（危险演示）
expected_output:
initial view =
[[0, 1, 2], [2, 3, 4]]
after view[0,2]=777:
  view = [[0, 1, 777], [777, 3, 4]]
  base a = [0, 1, 777, 3, 4, 5]
danger: a[2] is shared by view[1,0] -> corrupted
code:
import numpy as np
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import as_strided
a = np.arange(6, dtype=np.int64)
# 步长 2 的窗口：窗口之间共享元素（重叠）
view = as_strided(a, shape=(2, 3), strides=(2 * a.itemsize, a.itemsize))
print("initial view =")
print(view.tolist())
view[0, 2] = 777            # 写 a[2]
print("after view[0,2]=777:")
print("  view =", view.tolist())
print("  base a =", a.tolist())
print("danger: a[2] is shared by view[1,0] -> corrupted")
